description: "The Tragedy of the Chain Pier" by Charlotte M. Brame is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story unfolds in Brighton, primarily focusing on the contrast between the lively West Pier and the haunting Old Chain Pier, where tragedy and emotional turmoil linger.
